title: Battle of Hlobane
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hlobane", at revision 1379912338, opens: "The Battle of Hlobane took place at Hlobane, near the modern town of Vryheid in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa during the Anglo-Zulu War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1670862, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1879 battle of the Anglo-Zulu War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
